decisions.what: R3 harness: nearest-neighbour candidates via LSH cascade 32x4 → 64x2 → 128x1 (backfill under 32 candidates); the ≥0.6 missed-merge sweep uses 64x2; validation against the harness's own exhaustive run on a synthetic 324 corpus because the diagnosis sample was never preserved; re-validate at 803 before quoting corpus figures
decisions.why: builder measured 32x4 detecting at Jaccard 0.42; cascade reached median delta 0.0, max 0.084

decisions.what: Questions: stub wins over supervision (no questions on a stub); supervision rendered as a markup line on stubs with S1–S9 classes; S10-only stubs state that no regulator classification is recorded; template tails capped at four value-free words; doseStudied and approvalDate added to the field models; registry aggregates gain lastCompletionDate; seed 6 computable only from verbatim publication statements
decisions.why: executor builders' measured findings on repeated five-gram tails and missing slots

decisions.what: Gate 1 passed on the mandate's threshold (Tier 1 median 10 of 15). Phase 2b augments before Gate 1b: drop 'age-related' as a standalone longevity trigger (134 macular-degeneration programmes), admit pathway statements from cited abstract sentences (rapamycin/metformin mechanism text names FKBP12/complex I, not mTOR/AMPK), add doseStudied, approvalDate, lastCompletionDate, and repair fragment display names such as 'Dimethyl' from the FDA UNII display name
Gate 1b threshold applies to every tier: 449 Tier 1 pages below 7 present fields are noindex, reachable and promotable, and stay Tier 1 pages

Redirects answer 308 (Next permanentRedirect); the deployment check accepts 301 or 308. Loader writes atc_codes (ChEMBL, CC BY-SA noted), entity_class, top_rung, human_data and evidence_tier on corpus_pages so the class facet and the badge triplet cover every model. ITP doses render only with a printed unit. Corpus search hits merge into the results list with name, tier and field count; the home search bar itself is untouched. Dark ramp stays behind data-theme until the app shell adopts the tokens; light default ships.

Gate 1b re-measure did not clear (0.247 at the 803 draw) because seed 15 rendered a standing paragraph on 81% of indexed pages; evidence age now renders as a value inside the human-data block and never as its own block. Seed 7 admits the effect-word lemma family. Three CLINICAL templates (indication, regulatory-only, trial-history) cover 1,653 question-less non-stub pages. 'Who carried' replaces 'Who took' (take-family guard). Identity pass 2 accepted (23 merges, dimethyl split; metal complexes never stripped); pass2-pre copy deleted. Suppression re-run after the pass so ethane carries its own reading.

Gate 2 PROCEED. Pre-load fixes before Phase 5: (1) loader strips control characters from names and reads top-level doseStudied so present_field_count matches Gate 1b; (2) Gate 1b threshold rule is the cumulative reading (mandate: 'everything at or above enters the sitemap' → the indexed set's median ≤ 0.20) with a deploy procedure: measure the threshold-7 set through HTML in the disposable build; deploy with 7 if size-matched cumulative ≤ 0.20 and all-pairs ≤ 0.30, else 11 with 7–10 as the promotion criterion; (3) overflow-wrap on row labels and synonyms; (4) S10-only suppressed pages get a classification block ('What classification does {name} carry?' → 'No regulator classification is recorded') instead of a supervision claim; (5) seed 13 rows de-duplicated before the cap; (6) CLINICAL blocks: regulatory statuses render as rows (markup), the never-cleared jurisdiction list moves to /definitions, the unreported-trials sentence carries NCT ids so no fixed phrase exceeds four words; (7) withdrawn flag requires no remaining active application in that register (amlodipine was flagged while approved); (8) identity pass 3: structureless K1 pages whose name minus salt words equals another page's name merge as salts (Oxytocin acetate); (9) 'harness' renamed in specs for the copy check; the four-audience report regenerated.

Indexing threshold 11 present fields (636 pages) for the first deployment; 7–10 present fields is the promotion band, re-measured through live HTML after each tier deploys; the withdrawn rule now requires no remaining active application in a register (438 → 663 withdrawn, amlodipine cleared); identity pass 3 merged 111 salt-named structureless pages; gate hygiene before deploy: home facet link contrast, eslint ignores for captured third-party files under data/, prettier on the nine files, the literal "undefined" whyStopped quoted in rows, a withdrawn page added to the sample list

The pushed release carries code, specs, worklogs and small evidence files only; corpus data and measurement caches (3.56 GB tracked on local main, ten files over GitHub's 100 MiB limit) stay on the workstation, kept in the local branch archive/corpus-20k-full-history and a tarball under rnawiki-backups/corpus-20k-data-2026-09-05; production is loaded from local files and the export chain never reads them. After the merge the worktree's main is reset to origin/main with the data restored untracked.

Before Tier 2: (1) corpus pages emit JSON-LD built only from recorded identity and the first question's paragraph 1 — no invented fields; (2) IndexNow becomes corpus-aware: it submits exactly the URLs of a tier's sitemap child, with --tier; (3) R12 spec change: the facet index lists each value's letter sub-pages and page numbers inline so every indexed record is within three clicks; (4) discovery:monitor streams sitemap children with bounded memory and scopes by tier; (5) load markers record the target database identity so a disposable-run marker never counts for production; (6) verify-live waits for the 15-minute sitemap cache after a load.
